notes.title: Feel the Christmas spirit
notes.notes:
Hello, friends!

We are happy to introduce you our new game, created especially to fill your home with warmth and cheer on the eve of Christmas! If you remember and love the colorful characters from our hit "Bastard", then get ready to meet them again in a brand new adventure!
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/pTnF9S8L/4ktrio1-1.jpg[/img]

"Christmas Adventure" is a game where every corner is filled with holiday spirit and winter magic. New tasks, festive costumes for your favorite characters and a lot of surprises are waiting for you to create an unforgettable Christmas atmosphere right in your home.

Give yourself a little bit of magic - join the festive adventure today!

With love and Christmas wishes, Clerik Studio.
